chapter_title: The Invisible Living World: Beyond Our Naked Eye
executive_summary: Chapter 2 explores the microscopic realm of unicellular and multicellular organisms invisible to the unaided eye. It details magnification tools (lenses, compound microscopes, foldscopes), biological organization levels, major microbial groups (bacteria, protozoa, microalgae, fungi, acellular viruses), ecological roles, industrial uses (fermentation, decomposition, biogas), and traditional Indian perspectives ('Krimi').
key_takeaways: Master core concepts of The Invisible Living World: Beyond Our Naked Eye.
Understand real-world applications and experimental activities.
Analyze cause-and-effect relations and scientific definitions.

essential_vocabulary.definition: Tiniest living organisms invisible to the unaided human eye requiring optical magnification.
